# Themes and typography

Declare one project theme with `[assets.theme] source = "ui/theme.toml"`.
Game themes are inherited by level UI; a level may replace it with `[theme]
source = "..."`. Theme TOML is compiled into cartridges and never served.

```toml
extends = "dark" # the only built-in base in SDK 0.11

[colors]
surface = "#101927f5"
primary = "#27658aff"
primary-hover = "#3685b5ff"
text = "#f4f8ffff"

[spacing]
panel = 24
gap = 10

[typography]
body = 20
title = 30
body-family = "body"
title-family = "display"
mono-family = "mono"

[controls]
height = 48

[images.panel]
asset = "ui.panel"
slice = [24, 24, 24, 24] # top, right, bottom, left source pixels
```

Styles refer to `theme.colors.surface`, `theme.spacing.panel`,
`theme.typography.title`, `theme.controls.height`, and `theme.images.panel`.
Unknown bases/groups/tokens/images fail. An image names a declared texture; its
slice needs a positive stretchable center. Background images are nine-sliced;
foreground image/icon references use the same typed image ownership.

Typography roles are `body`, `display`, `mono`. Host built-ins are fallback.
Replace a role with one project-owned font:

```toml
[[assets.font]]
role = "display"
source = "assets/fonts/title.otf"
```

Roles are unique; source is a confined regular `.ttf`/`.otf`; the build parses
it before packaging. Only roles reachable from compiled UI are retained. Bytes
embed in `game.kart`, the host parses each retained face once, and no font is a
loose browser resource.
